# The International Journal of Indian Psychology

> A peer-reviewed academic journal publishing original research on psychology, mental health, education, and social issues in India.

IJIP publishes qualitative and quantitative research articles addressing contemporary psychological and educational challenges in the Indian context, with particular focus on mental health, online learning, tribal education, and social empowerment. The journal features contributions from researchers across Indian universities and institutions.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health
- Online Learning
- Tribal Education
- Scheduled Tribes & Adivasis
- Survey Research
- Qualitative Research
- Academic Burnout
- Dissociative Disorders
- Women Empowerment
- COVID-19 Impact
- Educational Barriers
- Literacy Gaps
- Media Psychology
- Lived Experiences
- India

## Education & Learning

- [Understanding Academic Burnout Among Indian Youth: The Role of Online Learning and Self-Regulation](https://ijip.in/articles/academic-burnout-youth): Study on academic burnout, online learning and self-regulation in Indian youth
- [The impact of online learning during COVID-19: students' and teachers' perspective](https://ijip.in/articles/the-impact-of-online-learning-during-covid-19-students-and-teachers-perspective): COVID-19 pandemic survey on online learning impacts from student and teacher perspectives
- [Scope of Education among Tribal Children in Telangana](https://ijip.in/scope): Research article on tribal education barriers and literacy gaps in Telangana

## Mental Health & Clinical Psychology

- [The Narratives and Lived Experiences of People with Derealization-Depersonalization Disorder](https://ijip.in/articles/derealization-depersonalization): Qualitative study on lived experiences of derealization-depersonalization disorder patients
- [Parental Death During Childhood and Its Effects on Adulthood: A Scoping Review](https://ijip.in/articles/death-childhood): Scoping review examining parental bereavement effects on adult mental health outcomes
- [Effect of Media on Human Behaviour](https://ijip.in/articles/effect-of-media-on-human-behaviour): Survey research on psychological impacts of media and digital technologies on human behavior

## Social Psychology & Empowerment

- [A Study on Perceived Women Empowerment in Female University Students](https://ijip.in/articles/female-women-empowerment): Survey study on women empowerment, autonomy and legal awareness in university students
- [Superstitious Behaviour between Male and Female All India Inter University Judo Players](https://ijip.in/articles/superstitious): Study on gender differences in superstitious behavior among Indian judo athletes
